_doc: film.json for the feature-walkthrough template (build_film.py reads it). Hooks are opt-in by key; delete a key for v4 behaviour.
skin: tools/skin_apply.py -> scenes/skin_data.js (+ design.md tokens). captions.ass: .ass + .srt + .vtt from the same groups the
lane burns in. chapters: one per feature (`chapter:` beats), no merge; starts snap to the feature cuts (cause chapter) in
seams.json. sfx.auto: cuts whoosh, one impact per act (the chapter cuts), tick on count-up landings, ui-confirm on the receipt
stamps; sync.json carries the stamps ({"t": ..., "kind": "stamp", "id": "r1:stamp", "force": true} if the narration is dense).
fx.buses: all three chains. bed_env: breathe -3 dB at every cut, no swell (no riser in a walkthrough).
events: tools/record_events.py telemetry for lib/cursor.js + lib/hud.js and tools/camera_from_events.py (pushes snap to the
nearest spoken word within +-0.4 s when vo/<name>_words.json exists); idle: tools/idle_detect.py proposals (scenes/idle.js).
name: film
